<DOCSTRING>
Summary: Represents a concrete implementation of the Game abstract class, managing player turns and game state.

Description: Created to handle specific game logic, used by game controllers or players for turn-based gameplay. The class manages the current player, places ships, and runs attacks.

Attributes:
    current_player (Player): The player whose turn it is, set during initialization and modified by the run method.

Methods:
    init: Sets the initial player for the game.
    run: Executes an attack by the current player at the specified row and column.
    place_ships: Places ships for a specified player on the game board.
</DOCSTRING>
